Definition: from G4183 and G4164; much variegated, i.e. multifarious:--manifold.
BiblicalUsage: Polypoikilos means much variegated, manifold, many-coloured. Paul uses it once, for the manifold wisdom of God, made known through the church to the principalities and powers in heavenly places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's wisdom is not one flat colour but many, and the church itself is where the world gets to see it.
